question: Yashovigraha, Mahichandra and Chandradeva were the first three rulers of ______ dynasty
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gahadvala**__.

__
 
• **Yashovigraha, Mahichandra** and **Chandradeva** were the **first three rulers** of the **Gahadvala dynasty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Gahadavals **of **Kannauj **ruled **North India** from the mid of the **11th century** till the mid of the **13th century AD**.
 
• **Yashovigraha** was the** founder** of the **Gahadavals dynasty**.** A strong & far-sighted ruler with well-planned policies**. 
 
• The** Gahadaval** kingdom expanded to **Delhi **and moved eastward to **Patna **and **Munjar areas** of** Bihar** and** Kannauj **was the **political center of Gahadavals.**
 
• Being a political center **Kannauj** experienced many **rules,** thus, it is today known for the distilling of **scents** and is a market center for **tobacco, perfume, **and **rose water.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Dynasty**
 **Details**
 
 

 **Wadiyar**
 
 
 
• The Wadiyar dynasty was founded by Yaduraya wadiyar in 1399.
 
• The Wadiyar dynasty was an Indian dynasty that ruled the Kingdom of Mysore from 1399 to 1950, with a brief interruption in the late 1700s.
 
 
 
 

 **Chauhans**
 
 
 
• According to the Bijolia inscription, the person named Vasudev Chauhan was the founder of the Chauhan dynasty, who started the kingdom in 551 E.
 
 
 
 

 **Maratha**
 
 
 
• The Maratha Empire or the Maratha Confederacy was a power that dominated a large portion of the Indian subcontinent in the 18th century.
 
• Maratha empire was founded in 1674.
 
• The Marathas were a Marathi-speaking warrior group from the western Deccan Plateau.
